crossRefs.note: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there…
This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

people.name: Mary
people.line: Mother of Jesus; wife of Joseph.

translations.web: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
translations.bsb: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.
translations.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
translations.asv: And they came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in the manger.
